text:
Rosa (Finance): Flagging a discrepancy: 48 invoices posted in NetSuite yesterday used an older FX rate, creating a $12k USD mismatch vs Stripe. Looks systemic, not manual.
Ethan (Billing Eng): I'm seeing webhook ordering issues in the sync logs. The fx-updates job wrote new rates to rates-service at 02:03 UTC but several invoice.created webhooks were processed at 02:02-02:05 and some picked the pre-update rate because our cache TTL is 5m.
Priya (Revenue Ops): Oof. That will misstate revenue and tax bases across subsidiaries. Month close in 5 days. Do we have DLQ evidence or replays?
RatesBot: rates-service: latest_rate: EUR->USD 1.0845 (applied 2026-03-26T02:03:12Z). Cached entries ttl=300s.
Sam (Platform): Confirmed: many sync workers read cached rate at 02:01 then kept using it for the batch. Root cause: cache invalidation race after rates publish. Also a jitter in webhook ordering from the queue meant some invoice events arrived between publish and cache refresh.
Rosa (Finance): Proposed remediation? We need audit-safe fix. Prefer backfill with adjustment entries in NS rather than editing posted invoices.
Ethan (Billing Eng): I can produce a dry-run CSV listing affected invoices + delta by querying sync_event logs and comparing applied_rate vs canonical_rate at post-time. Query I'll run (dry-run):
```
SELECT s.invoice_id, s.stripe_id, s.posted_rate, r.canonical_rate, s.currency, s.amount_local, (s.amount_local * (r.canonical_rate - s.posted_rate)) as usd_delta
FROM sync_events s JOIN rates_history r ON r.effective_at = (SELECT MAX(effective_at) FROM rates_history WHERE effective_at <= s.posted_at)
WHERE s.gateway='stripe' AND s.posted_at BETWEEN '2026-03-26T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-26T02:10:00Z';
```
Priya (Revenue Ops): CSV should include subsidiary, GL impact, and whether invoice is settled. We need to prioritize unsettled ones for automatic adjustment.
Sam (Platform): Short-term mitigation: reduce cache TTL to 30s and make rate publish trigger a cache invalidation message to workers. Will push a patch to staging and monitor.
Rosa (Finance): Timeline: need CSV by EOD today. If total USD delta < 20k and affected invoices < 200, we prefer automated adjustment run in weekend window with audit tags. If bigger, escalate to Finance Director.
Ethan (Billing Eng): I'll run dry-run now and post CSV to #finance-private. Will include idempotency keys, suggested action (adjustment_credit | journal_entry), and link to Stripe invoice.
Sam (Platform): Also will add alert: if rates_publish happens within 5m of any invoice.created spikes, send a warning to #eng-oncall.
Rosa (Finance): Also pause monthly_exports during the remediation window to avoid downstream duplication.
RatesBot: reminder: monthly-exports scheduled Wed 06:00 UTC.
Priya (Revenue Ops): OK go ahead with dry-run. Keep Legal in loop if cross-border tax base changes are non-trivial.
Ethan (Billing Eng): will update when CSV is ready.
